title: Laddu and the Super-Speedy Hide-and-Seek
moral: Good things come when we wait patiently.
description: It's hide-and-seek time in Masti Nagar, and Laddu is the seeker! But counting all the way to ten feels like FOREVER, so Laddu counts super-duper fast. Count from one to ten with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu the goat in this funny animated story about patience for kids aged 3 to 8.
outro: Remember, friends: good things come when we wait patiently! Shhh... Laddu is still counting in his dreams. Six... zzzz! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!

Nooo! He jumped from two to ten! Silly Laddu!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Laddu! You skipped all the middle numbers! Try again!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Okay, okay! One, two, skippity-skip... TEN!
He ran so fast... BONK! Right into Golu the goat!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Dadaji, counting to ten takes FOREVER! I can't wait!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Waiting is easy when you count slowly, beta. Let's count my mangoes, one by one...
Dadaji's moustache wiggled... and wiggled... SNORE! He fell asleep!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes! Now, count with us, friends!
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, TEN! Ten yellow mangoes! Can you say TEN?

narration.text: Laddu kept counting, right next to the sweet shop. Guess what he could smell?
Hot, sticky, yummmmy JALEBIS!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Seven... sniff sniff... eight... My tummy says PEEK, Laddu!
But Laddu did NOT peek. He waited, like a patient champion!
Behind him... jingle, jingle... somebody tiptoed away with a jalebi! Who was it?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Nine... TEN! Ready or not, here I come!

Zip! Chintu's glasses slid right down his nose.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Okay... it was a slightly wobbly plan!

narration.text: Laddu shared the jalebis with everyone, even Golu.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Again! Again! Laddu, you're the seeker!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Okay! I'll count slowly... One... two... three... four...

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Fiiive... zzzzz...
SNORE! Laddu counted so slowly, he fell asleep! Patience is good, Laddu, but not THAT much!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
